_about: Bench-only data for the vision critic, version 1 (feature deck-vision-critic, phase 1). The rubric itself is engine/deck/visual_rubric.json; canned messages and confirm bands stay here until phase 2 moves them into the rubric with an approved additive schema change. Nothing here reaches a deck, a prompt or an export.

v_one_focus.looks_at: Whether the eye lands on the title or one visual, or two or three blocks of equal weight compete.
v_one_focus.canned_message: The slide may not have one clear first thing to look at.
v_one_focus.on_fail: shown only (advisory at most); Review may offer 'Try another layout' as a click.

v_balance.looks_at: Content bunched in one corner or side with the rest bare.
v_balance.canned_message: The slide may have a large empty area.
v_balance.on_fail: acts only if the critic beats the band alone (see code_baseline); then switch_layout inside the band.
v_balance.confirm_band: corner share of ink >= 0.65 or ink share <= 0.04 (code fires at 0.8 and 0.02)

v_not_crowded.looks_at: Too many blocks, tight gaps, text wall to wall, small type everywhere.
v_not_crowded.on_fail: acts only if the critic beats the band alone; then switch to roomier. No slots before slice 4 means no confirm: left for the person.
v_not_crowded.confirm_band: a text slot at >= 90% of max_chars, or the slide over its density target

v_looks_finished.looks_at: Finish, spacing, hierarchy; a template left half filled.
v_looks_finished.canned_message: The slide may not look finished.
v_looks_finished.on_fail: shown only; the headline number for the bench and gallery.
v_looks_finished.applies_to: every presented slide, cover and last slide included

v_image_fits.looks_at: Subject, setting and mood of the picture against the title.
v_image_fits.canned_message: The picture may not match the slide's title.
v_image_fits.on_fail: shown only; Review offers 'Make a new picture' with its cost card.

v_image_clean.looks_at: Signs, labels, packaging, screens, watermarks, logos inside the picture itself.
v_image_clean.canned_message: The picture may contain text or a logo.
v_image_clean.on_fail: when acts, adds a flag (the guard's power, no more): the picture waits for a person.

v_text_on_image.looks_at: Words over busy or mid-tone parts of a photo; thin type on texture.
v_text_on_image.canned_message: Words over the picture may be hard to read.
v_text_on_image.on_fail: acts only if the critic beats the band alone; then add a scrim inside the band.
v_text_on_image.applies_to: slides with text over a picture
v_text_on_image.confirm_band: measured contrast under 7:1 behind any word on the picture (code fires under 4.5:1)

v_crop_ok.looks_at: Heads, faces, products or the subject cut at the slot's edge.
v_crop_ok.canned_message: The picture's subject may be cut off.
v_crop_ok.on_fail: never automatic (no code confirm); Review offers 'Re-centre the picture'.

v_one_style.looks_at: Colour, light, finish and kind of image across the deck.
v_one_style.canned_message: The pictures may not look like one set.
v_one_style.on_fail: bench and gallery only in version 1: 12 contact sheets cannot measure it. Graded later only with >= 20 seeded contact sheets.
v_one_style.applies_to: decks with 2 or more pictures (contact sheet)

v_rhythm.looks_at: The same layout over and over, or a jumble with no system.
v_rhythm.canned_message: The deck's layouts may look repetitive or random.
v_rhythm.on_fail: bench and gallery only in version 1, as v_one_style.
v_rhythm.applies_to: decks with 5 or more presented slides (contact sheet)
